title: Isolation Ledger: automated attestation signer and retention-report pipeline
creator: Maya Chen
description: Deliver an automated evidence-generation and attestation pipeline (the Isolation Ledger) for Dedicated tenants that produces cryptographically signed, retention-aware bundles proving tenant placement, node chain-of-custody, and enforced retention settings. The output artifacts should be consumption-ready for auditors (PDF/ZIP + manifest + signatures) and ingestible by the Redwood Console, tenant S3 endpoints, and an external compliance collector. This ticket scopes the service, signer, collector, and the retention metadata export path.
acceptance_criteria: Signed attestation bundles are generated on a configurable cadence (default: daily) containing: tenant manifest, node assignment timeline, location tags, retention policy snapshot, and evidence hashes
Bundles are signed with the platform attestation key and a signature verification endpoint is available to validate integrity (REST)
Retention and deletion metadata are reflected in the artifact and mapped to tenant-level retention settings (no drift between policy and export)
Automated delivery supports: Redwood Console archival, customer S3 endpoint (presigned upload), and external HTTPS webhook collector
Audit UI shows latest bundle status, last-signed timestamp, signature verification result, and delivery history
End-to-end tests for signature verification, bundle integrity, and delivery retries are included in CI
tasks: Design attestation schema (manifest format, required fields, hash algorithm, signature format)
Implement signer microservice with key rotation hooks and HSM/KMS integration
Build evidence bundler: collect node logs, placement events, retention-policy snapshot, and compute content-addressed hashes
Add delivery adapters: console store, presigned S3 upload, webhook client with retry/backoff policy
Expose verification API and integrate a lightweight signature verifier in Console
Author runbook for manual attest request and emergency re-sign procedure
Integrate into runtime release pipeline and add e2e tests
ci_checks: smoke: Console display of latest bundle
security_notes: Use KMS-backed asymmetric keys for signing; private key never leaves HSM
Key rotation needs to produce cross-signed artifacts for 30d overlap window
Access to raw node logs must be audited; produce redacted views for exported bundles where tenant requests redaction
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Attestation artifacts contain sensitive metadata that could leak topology -> Mitigation: redact sensitive fields and provide policy-driven redaction toggles
Risk: Delivery failure to customer S3 -> Mitigation: durable retry queue + fallback to Console archive + alert to customer
Risk: Signature key compromise -> Mitigation: emergency key revocation procedure + re-signing runbook
